# USA Anime Club — US search opportunities and AI-citable reporting
Research date: 2026-11-15. INTERNAL EDITORIAL PLANNING ONLY; do not publish as a visitor-facing page.

## Evidence limitations
- Google Trends **Trending Now**, US, past 24h was inspected at https://trends.google.com/trending?geo=US; the top visible entries were broad sports/current events, not an anime keyword ranking.
- The historical Google Trends Explore interface did not provide a downloadable comparable 90-day data series in this research environment. Consequently **none** of these articles has a verified Google Trends rank, monthly search volume, traffic forecast or keyword difficulty.
- PeerLogix's 2026-11-09 US anime streaming interest index (NOT search volume) prioritized The Apothecary Diaries, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, One Piece, Black Clover, Mushoku Tensei, Bleach, Re:Zero, Jujutsu Kaisen, Frieren: https://peerlogix.com/charts/ti-an-01/
- WEBTOON's live English ranking is a dynamic platform ranking, NOT Google Trends: https://www.webtoons.com/en/ranking/trending
- Editorial selection must prioritize verified US applicability, clear reader utility, and original evidence, not keyword stuffing. Existing URLs and content should be improved instead of duplicating search intent.

## Human approval gate
Before any new article or substantive rewrite:
1. Verify the official publisher/platform source is accessible and dated; note the last actual manual check. Record additional independent sources for multi-platform claims.
2. Compare Google Trends Explore (geo=US, Web Search, past 90 days and 12 months) within the same comparison set; inspect rising related queries and export actual data where accessible. This is **not** a substitute for query-level Google Search Console results.
3. Choose one reader question per article; write an answer directly supported by the cited records. Do not use fabricated numbers, made-up episode schedules, invented reviewers/interviews, or unconfirmed US streaming rights.
4. Add original usefulness: title-by-title tables, verified chapter/volume differences, publication history, direct source extracts within copyright limits, reproducible original comparisons, or verified platform tests.
5. Use descriptive unique title/description, one canonical URL, real dates, visible source links and readable sections; test schema and source citations. Existing content is not independently fact-checked merely because the static generator validates.
6. Track Google Search Console queries/pages, indexed status, clicks, CTR, and return visits. Measure referral traffic where identifiable; **AI citations are not promised nor fully observable in all services**.

Official Google guidance: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features and https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide. No special AI schema or mandatory llms.txt is necessary for Google AI Overview/Mode eligibility.
